_comment: Contract/overlay config surface for omnibase_compat. The canonical authority for endpoint URLs and config tunables that would otherwise be hardcoded Python literals or raw env reads (epic OMN-13556 / OMN-13564). Values support ${env.VAR} interpolation: the declared value is the authority, an env var of the named key overrides it at resolution time. This file is the contract surface — never reintroduce the URL/flag as a Python literal or a bare os.environ read.
